name: Accelerator Drone
effect: Summons a drone that occasionally grants an ally a Free Turn. Lasts 4 turns.
effect_short: Summons a drone that occasionally grants an ally a Free Turn. Lasts 3 turns.

name: Agility Infuser
effect: Target permanently gains +25 Agility for the rest of the mission.

name: Ale
effect: Restores 15 stamina for one ally.

name: Amplifier Drone
effect: Summons a drone that occasionally doubles an ally's POW and FCS. Lasts 6 turns.
effect_short: Summons a drone that occasionally doubles an ally's POW and FCS. Lasts 5 turns.

name: Antidote
effect: Dispels SkillType.Poison effects from target and grants SkillType.Poison immunity for 5 turns.

name: Beacon
effect: Applies Distortion that increases particles gained but also increases enemy level.

name: Blood Contract
effect: Target gains Dark Bargain skill for the rest of the mission.

name: Disintegration Bomb
effect: Deals 220-280 SkillType.Physical, 125-175 SkillType.Stun, and 80-120 SkillType.Fire damage to all enemies.
effect_short: Deals 330-420 SkillType.Physical, 125-175 SkillType.Stun, and 80-120 SkillType.Fire damage to all enemies.

name: Book
effect: Skill training book. Use via Skills menu.

name: Stimulant Pod
effect: Restores 10 stamina for all allies.

name: Celestial Call
effect: Target gains Meteor Strike skill for the rest of of the mission.

name: Cleansing Water
effect: Dispels all SkillType.Debuff from target and grants 3 Resist.

name: Coffee
effect: Resets target's sleep counter, and nullifies SkillType.Sleep damage taken by target for 5 turns.
effect_short: Resets target's sleep counter, and nullifies SkillType.Sleep damage taken by target for 3 turns.

name: Endurance Infuser
effect: Target permanently gains +25 Endurance for the rest of the mission.

name: Energy Drone
effect: Summons a drone that occasionally fully restores an ally's MP. Lasts 6 turns.
effect_short: Summons a drone that occasionally fully restores an ally's MP. Lasts 5 turns.

name: Snack
effect: Restores 75% of target ally's MP and 3% stamina.

name: Focus Infuser
effect: Target permanently gains +25 Focus for the rest of the mission.

name: Mead
effect: Restores 25 stamina for one ally.

name: Medical Drone
effect: Summons an automated drone that heals and revives allies. Lasts 6 turns.
effect_short: Summons an automated drone that heals and revives allies. Lasts 5 turns.

name: Medkit
effect: Target gains Medkit skill for the rest of battle. Grants Free Turn.

name: Paralysis Drone
effect: Summons a drone that occasionally resets an enemy's turn progress. Lasts 5 turns.
effect_short: Summons a drone that occasionally resets an enemy's turn progress. Lasts 4 turns.

name: Medicine
effect: Restores 50% of target ally's HP.

name: Power Core
effect: Powers up and activates Machinery.

name: Power Infuser
effect: Target permanently gains +25 Power for the rest of the mission.

name: Ritual Rites
effect: Target gains Ritual skill for the rest of the mission.

name: Sapping Glove
effect: Target gains Drain Punch skill for the rest of the mission.

name: Scanner
effect: All enemies' HP, MP, and Attributes become visible.

name: Shield Drone
effect: Summons a drone that occasionally applies a shield to an ally. Lasts 5 turns.
effect_short: Summons a drone that occasionally applies a shield to an ally. Lasts 4 turns.

name: Soul Gems
effect: Soul Gems, used in the crafting of Relics.

name: Speed Infuser
effect: Target permanently gains +25 Speed for the rest of the mission.

name: Stealth
effect: The entire party escapes from a non-boss battle.

name: Particles
effect: Temporal Particles, used to manifest objects and affect the timeline.

name: Transmogrifier
effect: Applies Distortion that converts books and relics into particles and soul gems on defeat.

name: Utility Drone
effect: Summons a drone that supports allies in various ways. Lasts 6 turns.
effect_short: Summons a drone that supports allies in various ways. Lasts 5 turns.

name: Volatile Drone
effect: Summons a drone that attacks enemies and eventually explodes.

name: Sacramental Wine
effect: Revives an ally with full HP and grants them a Free Turn.
effect_short: Revives an ally with full HP.
